name: Jest of Memory’s Rain
body:
School: Divination; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 free action when you fail a savings throw.

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You may reroll a failed saving throw and take the second result. You may only use this spell once per round.
